method: Read original whole-page JPEG images after directly viewing two contact sheets of all 84 actual PDF letter crops, incorporating user corrections L10/L11/L12 and review metadata. L44 and L61 uncertain; L79 visually resembles hard sign and is not treated as definitive. No old draft text fetched for these pages before freezing. Same conversational model, historical exposure cannot be excluded. Fixed first 12 CSL physical lines III/134 and first 8 II/134, chosen after seeing page images but before old draft retrieval. No isolated model baseline, no gold. Accents are provisional; do not normalize missing marks or silently expand abbreviations.

велъ оу҆чаше вѣрѣ Хв҃ѣ, кр҃ти женѫ Агриповѫ кесаря. Агрипа же
гнѣвъ и҆мѣа на Павла жены ради и҆ шед съ Жиды къ Нероноу
